camel_example: aliyun aidge ImageTranslationStandardAsync --region cn-hangzhou --SourceLanguage zh --ImageUrl 'https://example.com/image.jpg' --TargetLanguage en --version 2026-04-28 --method POST --force
description_en: Translates images tailored for e-commerce scenarios, supporting over 400 language directions (including bridged languages), accurately processing complex text layouts within images, and ensuring translated content matches the image context to help e-commerce platforms and developers easily achieve multilingual conversion and presentation of image content. It also returns layer information such as text position, font, and color to facilitate secondary editing of translation results in image editors
description_zh: 图片翻译产品专为电商图片定制，支持 400 多种语向（含桥接），精确处理图片内的复杂文本布局，并确保翻译内容能够与图片内容匹配，帮助电商平台和开发者轻松实现图像内容的多语言转换与呈现。同时，产品支持返回图片中文字的位置、字体、颜色等图层信息，便于接入图片编辑器对翻译结果进行二次编辑
